Let `R_sq = max_{p in S} ||p||^2` and `D_sq = min_{p_i != p_j in S} ||p_i - p_j||^2`. The condition is `R_sq <= D_sq`.

A common strategy for this type of problem is to select all points from a single "shell" of a lattice, meaning all points have the same squared L2 norm, say `K`. In this case, `R_sq = K`.
